sentences.text_target: David stared at the clutter inside his kitchen drawer.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd stɛərd æt ðə ˈklʌtər ˈɪnsaɪd hɪz ˈkɪtʃən drɔːər/
sentences.text_native: David regardait le désordre à l'intérieur de son tiroir de cuisine.

sentences.text_target: He needed to retrieve a specific medication box.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈniːdɪd tuː rɪˈtriːv ə spəˈsɪfɪk ˌmɛdɪˈkeɪʃən bɒks/
sentences.text_native: Il avait besoin de retrouver une boîte de médicaments spécifique.

sentences.text_target: The small print on the label seemed rather confusing today.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə smɔːl prɪnt ɒn ðə ˈleɪbəl siːmd ˈræðər kənˈfjuːzɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Les petits caractères sur l'étiquette semblaient plutôt confus aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: He wanted to avoid any mistake that could lead him to misinterpret the instructions.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈwɒntɪd tuː əˈvɔɪd ˈɛni mɪˈsteɪk ðæt kʊd liːd hɪm tuː ˌmɪsɪnˈtɜːprɪt ðə ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz/
sentences.text_native: Il voulait éviter toute erreur qui pourrait le conduire à mal interpréter les instructions.

sentences.text_target: Professional guidance was clearly necessary before taking another dose.
sentences.phonetic: /prəˈfɛʃənl ˈɡaɪdəns wɒz ˈklɪərli ˈnɛsəsəri bɪˈfɔːr ˈteɪkɪŋ əˈnʌðər dəʊs/
sentences.text_native: Un avis professionnel était clairement nécessaire avant de prendre une autre dose.

sentences.text_target: Therefore, he decided to call the local pharmacist to verify everything.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈðɛəfɔːr, hiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː kɔːl ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈfɑːrməsɪst tuː ˈvɛrɪfaɪ ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Par conséquent, il décida d'appeler le pharmacien local pour tout vérifier.

sentences.text_target: The expert on the phone confirmed how the tablets should be taken.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈɛkspɜːrt ɒn ðə fəʊn kənˈfɜːrmd haʊ ðə ˈtæblɪts ʃʊd biː ˈteɪkən/
sentences.text_native: L'expert au téléphone a confirmé comment les comprimés devaient être pris.

sentences.text_target: Being cautious, David did not hesitate to ask multiple questions.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈbiːɪŋ ˈkɔːʃəs, ˈdeɪvɪd dɪd nɒt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tuː ɑːsk ˈmʌltɪpl ˈkwɛstʃənz/
sentences.text_native: Étant prudent, David n'a pas hésité à poser de multiples questions.

sentences.text_target: Every single detail on the packaging provided an important clue.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡl ˈdiːteɪl ɒn ðə ˈpækɪdʒɪŋ prəˈvaɪdɪd ən ɪmˈpɔːrtənt kluː/
sentences.text_native: Chaque détail sur l'emballage fournissait un indice important.

sentences.text_target: It was easy to overlook a crucial hourly interval in the daily schedule.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ˈiːzi tuː ˌəʊvəˈlʊk ə ˈkruːʃəl ˈaʊərli ˈɪntərvəl ɪn ðə ˈdeɪli ˈʃɛduːl/
sentences.text_native: Il était facile de négliger un intervalle d'une heure crucial dans l'horaire quotidien.

sentences.text_target: An accurate measurement of the liquid medicine was also required.
sentences.phonetic: /ən ˈækjʊrət ˈmɛʒərmənt ɒv ðə ˈlɪkwɪd ˈmɛdɪsɪn wɒz ˈɔːlsəʊ rɪˈkwaɪərd/
sentences.text_native: Une mesure précise du médicament liquide était également requise.

sentences.text_target: He needed to configure a digital reminder on his mobile device.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈniːdɪd tuː kənˈfɪɡər ə ˈdɪdʒɪtl rɪˈmaɪndər ɒn hɪz ˈməʊbaɪl dɪˈvaɪs/
sentences.text_native: Il avait besoin de configurer un rappel numérique sur son appareil mobile.

sentences.text_target: The alarm would ring promptly when the next administration time arrived.
sentences.phonetic: /ði əˈlɑːrm wʊd rɪŋ ˈprɒmptli wɛn ðə nɛkst ədˌmɪnɪˈstreɪʃən taɪm əˈraɪvd/
sentences.text_native: L'alarme sonnerait rapidement lorsque le moment de la prochaine administration arriverait.

sentences.text_target: Adhering to a strict protocol ensured a better health outcome.
sentences.phonetic: /ədˈhɪərɪŋ tuː ə strɪkt ˈprəʊtəkɒl ɪnˈʃʊərd ə ˈbɛtər hɛlθ ˈaʊtˌkʌm/
sentences.text_native: Respecter un protocole strict garantissait un meilleur résultat de santé.

sentences.text_target: The pharmacist warned him against altering the recommended quantity.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑːrməsɪst wɔːrnd hɪm əˈɡɛnst ˈɔːltərɪŋ ðə ˈrɛkəmɛndɪd ˈkwɒntɪti/
sentences.text_native: Le pharmacien l'a mis en garde contre la modification de la quantité recommandée.

sentences.text_target: Any deviation could trigger an unwanted side effect like severe drowsiness.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˌdiːviˈeɪʃən kʊd ˈtrɪɡər ən ˈʌnwɒntɪd saɪd ɪˈfɛkt laɪk sɪˈvɪər ˈdraʊzinəs/
sentences.text_native: Toute déviation pouvait déclencher un effet secondaire indésirable comme une somnolence sévère.

sentences.text_target: David listened carefully to every single warning about potential risks.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd ˈlɪsənd ˈkɛrfʊli tuː ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡl ˈwɔːrnɪŋ əˈbaʊt pəˈtɛnʃəl rɪsks/
sentences.text_native: David a écouté attentivement chaque avertissement concernant les risques potentiels.

sentences.text_target: He wrote down the exact frequency and duration in his notebook.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː rəʊt daʊn ði ɪɡˈzækt ˈfriːkwənsi ænd djʊˈreɪʃən ɪn hɪz ˈnʊtbʊk/
sentences.text_native: Il a écrit la fréquence exacte et la durée dans son carnet.

sentences.text_target: This proper routine would help him achieve a steady recovery.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈprɒpər ruːˈtiːn wʊd hɛlp hɪm əˈtʃiːv ə ˈstɛdi rɪˈkʌvəri/
sentences.text_native: Cette routine appropriée l'aiderait à obtenir un rétablissement régulier.

sentences.text_target: Optimal health outcomes depended heavily on this personal discipline.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɒptɪməl hɛlθ ˈaʊtˌkʌmz dɪˈpɛndɪd ˈhɛvɪli ɒn ðɪs ˈpɜːrsənl ˈdɪsɪplɪn/
sentences.text_native: Des résultats de santé optimaux dépendaient fortement de cette discipline personnelle.

sentences.text_target: His stomach had felt weak lately, requiring a gentle treatment plan.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈstʌmək hæd fɛlt wiːk ˈleɪtli, rɪˈkwaɪərɪŋ ə ˈdʒɛntl ˈtriːtmənt plæn/
sentences.text_native: Son estomac s'était senti faible ces derniers temps, nécessitant un plan de traitement doux.

sentences.text_target: Taking food alongside the pills prevented any heavy discomfort.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈteɪkɪŋ fuːd əˈlɒŋsaɪd ðə pɪlz prɪˈvɛntɪd ˈɛni ˈhɛvi dɪsˈkʌmfərt/
sentences.text_native: Prendre de la nourriture en même temps que les pilules évitait tout inconfort important.

sentences.text_target: The patient record showed continuous progress over the last week.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪʃənt ˈrɛkərd ʃəʊd kənˈtɪnjuəs ˈprəʊɡrəs ˈəʊvər ðə lɑːst wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Le dossier du patient montrait des progrès continus au cours de la semaine dernière.

sentences.text_target: Resolving his persistent cough remained the main objective today.
sentences.phonetic: /rɪˈzɒlvɪŋ hɪz pəˈsɪstənt kɒf rɪˈmeɪnd ðə meɪn əbˈdʒɛktɪv təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Résoudre sa toux persistante restait l'objectif principal aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: Proper storage conditions also mattered for maintaining drug stability.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈprɒpər ˈstɔːrɪdʒ kənˈdɪʃənz ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈmætərd fɔːr ˈmeɪnteɪnɪŋ drʌɡ stəˈbɪlɪti/
sentences.text_native: Des conditions de stockage appropriées importaient également pour maintenir la stabilité du médicament.

sentences.text_target: Leaving bottles near a warm kitchen window was a bad idea.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈliːvɪŋ ˈbɒtəlz nɪər ə wɔːrm ˈkɪtʃən ˈwɪndəʊ wɒz ə bæd aɪˈdiːə/
sentences.text_native: Laisser des bouteilles près d'une fenêtre de cuisine chaude était une mauvaise idée.

sentences.text_target: He placed every medical container safely on a dark pantry shelf.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pleɪst ˈɛvri ˈmɛdɪkl kənˈteɪnər ˈseɪfli ɒn ə dɑːrk ˈpæntri ʃɛlf/
sentences.text_native: Il a placé chaque contenant médical en toute sécurité sur une étagère de garde-manger sombre.

sentences.text_target: Such concerns vanished once he understood the instructions fully.
sentences.phonetic: /sʌtʃ kənˈsɜːrnz ˈvænɪʃt wʌns hiː ˌʌndəˈstʊd ði ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz ˈfʊli/
sentences.text_native: De telles préoccupations ont disparu une fois qu'il a pleinement compris les instructions.

sentences.text_target: He felt a wave of relief knowing his health was improving.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː fɛlt ə weɪv ɒv rɪˈliːf ˈnəʊɪŋ hɪz hɛlθ wɒz ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il a ressenti une vague de soulagement en sachant que sa santé s'améliorait.

sentences.text_target: Tomorrow morning would mark the successful completion of this cycle.
sentences.phonetic: /təˈmɒrəʊ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ wʊd mɑːrk ðə səkˈsɛsfʊl kəmˈpliːʃən ʌv ðɪs ˈsaɪkl/
sentences.text_native: Demain matin marquerait la fin réussie de ce cycle.
